review_scope: Working-tree source audit of all 53 crosswalk groups, V1/V3/V4 versus explicit V2 reachable workflows; June inventory reconciled as historical.
source_snapshot_note: Line references describe the inspected working tree; source can evolve during main-task conversion. Reconcile moved lines against symbols. Historical crosswalk labels and suite names are preserved as provenance, not fresh evidence.

requirements: Verified functional parity, including explicit resolution of missing/partial/unverified tasks and truthful unavailable boundaries.
Andrew approval before any legacy deletion or retirement.

audit_mutations: Only this Markdown and JSON audit documentation created; no app, runtime, configuration, model, image or Git mutation.

browser_runtime_evidence.note: verified_pass means a passing V2-targeted suite exercises the row's stated V2 task (see v2_runtime_scope). Suites do not run live inference; real-runtime checks are recorded separately in the runtime evidence file.

browser_runtime_evidence_owner: Main task to append actual V2 browser results after conversion; historical or V4 results must not be relabeled V2.

definitions.present: Source-level reachable entry/handler identified; runtime status remains unverified.
definitions.partial: Some underlying tasks reachable; concrete missing entry, restricted contract or incomplete coverage recorded.
definitions.missing: No V2 equivalent entry found for the inspected functional task.
definitions.unavailable: Current legacy/source boundary offers no working operation to port; keep gate truthful.
definitions.unverified: Entry found but relevant functional depth not inspected or executed sufficiently.

prioritized_v2_improvements.action: Expose supported V2 CLIP skip, VAE tiling, eta and RNG, full scheduler choices and CFG zero; verify exact effective requests and unsupported-field handling.
Resolve the unsupported V2 Workstation palette destination and preserve useful continuation tasks in V2; validate navigation and return-state recovery.
Expose server-backed style management and normalized request/command preview in V2 without touching protected style/wildcard data or tests unless separately authorized.
Expose useful help/settings guidance, contextual information and checkpoint file verification through V2-owned entry points.
Append actual V2 browser/task results per row, distinguish mock requests from real workers and human acceptance, then resolve historical gaps and unavailable boundaries before any retirement request.
